rows.grounds: object joined by enclitic; continues what the vidyā draws or reveals
ablative source compound with following noun; indicates origin in the divine realm
genitive plural with inclusive particle; marks secrecy even from the learned

items.question: What hidden knowledge does the trailokyākarṣiṇī vidyā make accessible to its possessor?
premises: The trailokyākarṣiṇī vidyā draws even distant cosmic entities.
It brings accounts from the abode of the gods.
It reveals secrets inaccessible even to the wise.
items.inference: Possession of this vidyā grants access to divine and otherwise hidden knowledge.
uncertainties: Whether vṛttāntañca and rahasya are parallel objects of attraction or revelation is contextually inferred.
items.plain_english: And it brings accounts and secrets from the abode of the gods, unknown even to the wise.
